camel_example: aliyun oceanbasepro DescribeMetricsDataV2 --region cn-hangzhou --Metrics sql_all_rt --EndTime '2023-04-12T05:38:38Z' --InstanceId ob317v4uif0000 --GroupByLabels clusterId --StartTime '2023-04-12T04:38:38Z' --Labels 'clusterId:ob000'
description_en: You can call this operation to return metric data
kebab_example: aliyun oceanbasepro describe-metrics-data-v2 --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --metrics sql_all_rt --start-time 2023-04-12T04:38:38Z --end-time 2023-04-12T05:38:38Z --labels clusterId:ob000 --group-by-labels clusterId --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeMetricsDataV2

parameters.help_en: The ID of the OceanBase cluster.
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The metrics. Separate multiple metrics with commas (,). Example: "sql_all_count,sql_all_rt..."
parameters.help_zh:
监控指标。
多个指标之间用逗号分隔。例如："sql_all_count,sql_all_rt..."
parameters.name: metrics

parameters.help_en: The start time, in the format of YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time, in the format of YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
A string of key-value pairs separated with commas (,). Each key and its value are separated with a colon (\:). Multiple values of a key are separated with semicolons (\;). Example: "clusterId:ob\\\,tenantId:t\\\;t\\\\,serverId:\\*,zoneId:cn-hangzhou-j". The string can contain only the following fixed keys: 
clusterId: the ID of the OceanBase cluster. 
tenantId: the ID of the OceanBase Database tenant. 
zoneId: the ID of the zone.
serverId: the ID of the OBServer node
parameters.help_zh:
一组 kv 组成的字符串，key、value 之间用冒号分隔，kv 对之间用逗号分隔，同一 key 不同 value 间用分号分隔。例如："clusterId:ob*****,tenantId:t******;t*******,serverId:*****,zoneId:cn-hangzhou-j"。
key 为固定字段： clusterId：表示 OceanBase 集群 ID。 tenantId：表示 OceanBase 租户 ID。 zoneId：表示 OB zone ID。 serverId：表示 OBServer 节点 ID
parameters.name: labels

parameters.help_en: The one or more keys used for grouping. Separate multiple keys with commas (,). Example: "clusterId,tenantId"
parameters.help_zh: 用于分组的字段。多个字段之间用逗号分隔。例如："clusterId,tenantId"
parameters.name: group_by_labels

parameters.help_en:
The sorting rule. Valid values: 
ASC: in ascending order 
DESC: in descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序规则。
升序：ASC。
降序：DESC
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The length of the data array returned after sorting
parameters.help_zh: 排序后返回的 Data 数组长度
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The type of the replica. Node filtering conditions are configured based on the replica type when you query the monitoring data of the OceanBase cluster. 
By default, the replica type is not specified when you query the monitoring data of OceanBase clusters or the access proxy. If you do not specify the replica type when you query the monitoring data of an OceanBase cluster, the monitoring data of all nodes is queried. 
If you set the replica type to FULL when you query the monitoring data of an OceanBase cluster, the monitoring data of only the full-featured replica nodes is queried.
If you set the replica type to READONLY when you query the monitoring data of an OceanBase cluster, the monitoring data of only the read-only replica nodes is queried
parameters.help_zh:
副本类型。
OceanBase 集群监控根据副本类型设置节点过滤条件。 默认不传, 可用于 OceanBase 监控或查询访问代理监控，查询 OceanBase 监控时，表示查询所有副本类型节点的监控数据。 FULL，仅对 OceanBase 监控生效，表示只查询全功能副本节点上的监控数据。 READONLY，仅对 OceanBase 监控生效，表示只查询只读副本节点上的监控数据
parameters.name: replica_type
